text:
Maria K: quick design sync — re: rollback UX on the timeline. putting the proto up: https://figma.com/file/xyz/rollback-toast
Sahil P: saw it, looks cleaner. two quick things: toast timing feels short for slower networks, and the history fade when you scroll is kinda janky on mobile. :thinking_face:
Devin R: agree on toast. i think we need 6s default with an option to 'hold' if keyboard focus lands on it. otherwise users miss the undo.
Anya L: +1. also let's make the toast accessible — announce via aria-live so screen readers pick up "Rollback initiated. Undo available for 6 seconds."
Sahil P: SGTM. on history fade — the gradient masks the version labels when you scroll fast. maybe animate opacity instead of clip-path? smoother and less layout shift.
Maria K: good call. can we do a quick CSS sample?
Devin R: yep. small snippet:
```
.toast { animation: fade-in .12s ease; }
.history-label[aria-hidden="true"] { opacity: 0.4; transition: opacity .16s ease; }
```
Anya L: for screen readers, use `role="status" aria-live="polite"` and ensure the toast is focusable (`tabindex=0`) so keyboard users can hit undo. also add `aria-label="Rollback completed, undo"` on the button.
Maria K: copy nit: current toast text says "Rolled back — Undo" which reads weird. propose: "Rollback initiated — Undo" and after completion change to "Rollback complete" (no undo).
Sahil P: i like that. also what about an explicit timestamp in the history item (e.g., "v12 — rolled back 2m ago") for quick confirmation?
Devin R: yeah, but keep density low. maybe show timestamp on hover and via screen reader always. that keeps visual tidy.
Anya L: contrast check: our rollback pill is blue 400 on white — fails AA at small sizes. need to bump to blue 600 or add a 1px outline when text is small.
Maria K: noted — design task to update tokens. @rollout-bot can you record a follow-up: change toast timing to 6s, add aria-live + role=status, update copy, increase contrast on pill, animate opacity on history labels, timestamp via SR?
rollout-bot: Action created: ROLLBACK-UX-216 — "Toast timing, a11y announcements, copy & timeline fade" assigned to @Devin R, due 3 days. :white_check_mark:
Sahil P: will test keyboard flow after Devin's changes. also propose micro-interaction: a subtle slide from bottom for the toast instead of pop — feels more discoverable.
Devin R: can prototype slide + focus trap. will ping here when ready.
Maria K: awesome. last thing — can we add an optional "replay" affordance on each history item (small play icon) to preview the diff? not in this sprint but add to backlog.
Anya L: backlog item created: ROLLBACK-REPLAY-34.
Maria K: thanks team — i'll update the figma and the design doc with the copy and token changes. will circle back in 48h. :sparkles:
